title: The characteristic polynomial of multiplication by T on R[T]/(f) is f
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring and $f\in R[T]$ monic of degree $n$. Then the characteristic polynomial of the $R$-linear map $\mu_t:R[T]/(f)\to R[T]/(f)$, $x\mapsto tx$ (where $t$ is the class of $T$), on the free $R$-module $R[T]/(f)$ with basis $1,t,\dots,t^{n-1}$, is $f$.
